name: events-wait
description: Long-poll for the NEXT matching Unity event. Match by contains (case-insensitive log substring) or marker (exact planted-beacon name). Waits for FUTURE events by default; events that fire DURING a trigger (Play-mode enter, recompile, script-execute) are skipped unless you capture sinceEventId before the trigger (e.g. bridge-get-status lastEventId) or pass includeRecentMs. timedOut:true is a normal branch, not a failure: read result.diagnostic and recover with events-check-since.

marker.description: Exact planted beacon name (a string, not a boolean).

sinceEventId.description: Only events after this id. Capture from bridge-get-status before the trigger so events during it aren't missed.

includeRecentMs.description: Also match events from the last N ms (race look-back); keep small.

timeoutMs.description: Max ms before timedOut:true (a normal branch).

source.description: Advanced: restrict to one event origin. Defaults to any source.

type.description: Advanced: restrict to one internal event type.

level.description: Advanced: restrict by severity (e.g. Error, Warning, Log).

includeData.description: Include the event's structured data payload in the result.
